edits.after: Wither lands here: 15s at rank 1, and it saps your attack speed mid-Vital. Trade only in that window, never through it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Wither's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Parry the wrong spell or eat Wither on your engage and the all-in fails; bait the 15s slow out first and your Vital chain holds.

edits.before: Ravenous Hydra is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Wither's cooldown.
edits.after: His Sheen item sizes up Siphoning Strike faster than Hydra helps you — close on plates and tower.

edits.before: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins any committed duel — build your teamfight around that. Nasus carry threat: 10/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
